name: Roo
description: Roo is a very sweet girl that came to us as a stray after being tied up and abandoned. She is a really sweet girl who has grown in confidence since her arrival – she loves people!Roo is an active girl who will benefit from daily exercise and mental stimulation in order to keep her satisfied. She is enjoying her walks and being out and about. She is healthy and athletic – we feel that she would potentially make a good running buddy! Roo is estimated to be around 1-2 years old (no microchip for us to know for sure) and is a switched on girl. New owners must be willing to continue her training and socialisation once she goes home. She is looking for a home with sensible children aged 8+ who are used to bouncy dogs (younger children will be considered depending on the home). We have introduced Roo to other dogs since her arrival and she has mixed well, she can be nervous and unsure at times but is growing in confidence daily. We feel that she does have potential to be rehomed with another dog as long as introductions go well here at the rescue. We do not have any history on her around cats so she is looking for a cat-free home.She is food motivated which will help with her training. She really does have so much potential and is a stunning girl, so we really hope a suitable home comes along soon.

name: Holly
description: Holly is such a beautiful girl who came into us as a stray back in December 2023, she is looking for her new forever home which we can’t wait for her to find as she is wasted in kennels!

Holly is a lovely girl who has lots of love to give! She is affectionate and cuddly with people she knows but can be initially quite timid, however she is easily won round with time + treats! She can be timid of new environments but does tend to look to her handler for guidance. When she panics on walks, around traffic, busy public places, she can panic and put the brakes on – she can be very strong and stubborn so will need an owner that can manage this. However, once she settles she really enjoys being out and about on adventures or running around our secure off lead areas here at the rescue!
Her recall is quite hit and miss, typical of her breed! But she is very food motivated which definitely helps with training. Holly will require a secure garden with tall fences.

Since she has been with us she has met a large variety of different dogs and has been fantastic with them, she walks well with them and has also showed great social skills when off lead with them too. She has the potential to live with a compatible dog as long as the introductions go well here at the rescue. Being a Hound Holly would not be suitable to live with cats or other small furries.

Due to her coming into us as a stray, we don’t have any background history on her but she has been in two foster homes which allowed us to learn more about her and we can explain her more to anyone interested. She was in a foster home with two other smaller dogs – which she loved and seemed very confident, however she was quite boisterous for the older, smaller dogs which is why it was only a short foster.
Also, in one of the foster home she became quite timid and showed some guarding behaviours, due to this we are looking for an adult only home for Holly.
Overall she is an amazing girl who is a firm favourite here at NCAR and we hope a suitable home comes along for her soon!
Holly is a large breed, she is a hound, weighing around 30kg. We have been told the photos can be quite deceiving and that she looks small, beagle size, she is quite a big girl who is strong on lead.

name: Nugget
description: Nugget is a friendly, energetic bully breed that arrived as a stray in March 2025. She was adopted last year, but has sadly been returned due to her behaviour in the home.

Nugget is a friendly girl with everyone she meets. When she first arrived at the rescue, she was very playful and cheeky, she loved our off-lead paddock and playing with toys. She was friendly and always wanted to say hi to people during her stay in a home. She lived in an adult only home, and reportedly fine around kids outside of the home, but due to her coming in as a stray and her adult-only previous home, we are looking at a home with adults only. We can reasses this for the right home with older sensible children.

When Nugget arrived to the resuce, we did some testing with her around dogs and it was mostly positive. She was friendly, but could be quite intense and unsure if they reacted to her. She was sadly returned to the rescue due to biting two dogs. We can go into more information with anyone interested in her. Her previous home said she would be interested and want to interact with other dogs, but if they reacted/snapped at her, she would react. Again, we can provide more information on her previous behaviour and how to manage this behaviour in the next, and hopefully forever, home.

She can be strong on lead, but has improved since last year. She is house trained, both here and in a home, travels well in the car and is well behaved at the vets. Generally she is a fab girl, she’s very playful with toys, loves people and can be a funny, crazy girl! We hope someone is able to work with her and see her amazing potential.
